description: Implementation of QuicSimpleServerPacketWriter class for handling QUIC packet writing over UDP socket.

classes.name: QuicSimpleServerPacketWriter
classes.description: A class responsible for writing QUIC packets over a UDP socket, managing write states and packet size limits.

methods.name: QuicSimpleServerPacketWriter
methods.description: Constructor initializing socket and dispatcher references.

methods.name: OnWriteComplete
methods.description: Callback invoked upon completion of a write operation, updates write state and notifies dispatcher.

methods.name: IsWriteBlocked
methods.description: Returns whether the writer is currently blocked from writing.

methods.name: MessageTooBigErrorCode
methods.description: Returns error code indicating message size exceeded limit.

methods.name: WritePacket
methods.description: Attempts to write a packet to the socket, returns the result.

methods.name: SupportsReleaseTime
methods.description: Indicates whether release time support is available.

methods.name: IsBatchMode
methods.description: Indicates whether batch mode is supported.

methods.name: GetNextWriteLocation
methods.description: Provides buffer for the next write operation.

methods.name: Flush
methods.description: Flushes any buffered data, returns write result.
